design.name: DeepArcade
design.question: Which Snake agent performs best, and what does its learning behavior reveal?
design.brief: Five policies · one seeded evaluation arena
design.classification: Real recorded training and seeded game evaluation runs
design.north: Let an RL reviewer compare evaluated behavior while respecting different sample sizes and conditions.
design.layout: Five-agent bestiary roster driving a large distribution view; asymmetric training and strategy panels; genuine playable game.
limits: Evaluation uses classic 12×12 Snake and fixed seeds. Most agents have 500 games; MCTS has 50.
Raw histogram counts have different denominators and must not be treated as equal-sample densities.
The reported MCTS uses 80 simulations per move. The browser adjusts its search budget for responsiveness.
Learners trained on classic boards; maze-game behavior is a different evaluation condition.

source: Committed repository data and reviewed dashboard arrays
